title: Her Daily Routine: Naming Her Friends

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after filming Aston Machan's video.
While walking under an overpass on my way back from shopping...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're very fluffy, Mr. Fluff-Fluff.
So fluffy I feel like I might catch your fluffiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came across her relaxing. ...For some reason, a white pigeon
was beside her, and she was casually chatting with it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
You must be... the Trainer from the video the other day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Machan never forgets.
Once I meet someone, I remember them forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan stated this with unusual seriousness.
The pigeon beside her let out a "coo-coo" as if chiming in.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A friend. Not a pet.
Though we did just meet moments ago.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was taking a nap, and when I woke up, it was sleeping next to me.
And so, we were having a little chat together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A wild pigeon just wandering over to nap beside someone... does that actually happen?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Chloe Harvard introduced us,
since she lives around here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, or maybe Shinobimaru Hattori. Or was it Mr. Arimura?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Shall I introduce you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was taken to be introduced.
Led to the edge of the shopping district, what I met was—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Miss Chloe, you're looking energetic as ever today.
How are the babies doing?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caww!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Shinobimaru Hattori~!
Ehehe, it's so nice out today, perfect for an afternoon nap.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meoow.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're such a hard worker, Mr. Arimura.
Did you find some new food?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Then it might be a good idea to take a break soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There's something I want to show you, Mr. Arimura.
Machan's special treasure. Would you like to see it? Yes, of course you would.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And so, shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: To the special treasure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with the ant resting on her hand, where she led me was...
an Umamusume merchandise shop in the city.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are no Machan mascots yet. In fact, there isn't
a single piece of merch. I really wanted to show Mr. Arimura, too...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was super eye-catching in the mock race the other day, though.
The road to becoming an ultra-super mascot is long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside how rare it is for merch to be made before a debut...
I recalled her talking about becoming a "mascot" before.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan's dream is to become a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Appearing in every corner of the world, held in everyone's hands...
That kind of super—no, ultra-super mascot is what I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the look of things, Aston Machan's talk
about "wanting to be a mascot" was surprisingly serious.
choice_data_list: (But why make that her goal in racing...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most horsegirls debut out of passion and longing for the races themselves,
or for personal fulfillment achieved through success on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Debuting purely to get merchandise made was unprecedented.
Her motives were a complete mystery.
choice_data_list: Why is getting merchandise made your goal?
Why is getting merchandise made your goal?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is a top-priority mission. An Aston Machan in every household.
I think it would be wonderful if an era like that arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It seemed to be her habit to always give slightly elusive answers.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How it started, you mean? Well, you see... A few years ago.
Back when Machan was just a tiny bit smaller than she is now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an oddly solemn expression,
Aston Machan began to speak fluidly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan was troubled. Even though the Machan dolls were finished,
I didn't know how to hand them out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How could I get everyone to take one in their hands?
Isn't there an innovative, more efficient way than handing them out directly?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Rage-bait marketing—do something bad that makes headlines on talk shows!
...Rejected. I don't want to be called Aston Villain-chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then study business! ...Hmm, not bad.
While formulating that strategy, I also wanted a quick method.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't quite think of a good idea. Then one day—
Machan happened to visit an Umamusume merchandise shop.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And there... lo and behold...
were Umamusume mascots selling like hotcakes...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It was astonishing! I had no idea that mascots of
horsegirls who excelled in races were sooooo popular!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mascots loved by everyone...
I see. With this... if I do this... Machan too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, Machan enrolled in Tracen Academy,
scheming to make a name for herself in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood that her enrollment was entirely based on getting merch made, and that
her passion for merchandise was extraordinary. However—
choice_data_list: (Why did she want merch made in the first place?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether she forgot to mention that fundamental reason or skillfully dodged it,
there was no answer in her words. Although curious—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The dream is nationwide expansion, and then global expansion.
Right now, alongside racing, I am also studying bookkeeping. Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan has fortunately been lovely since the day she was born, so
she thinks winning her debut should make everything work out nicely.
choice_data_list: (...Maybe she just likes being the center of attention.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting that answer at face value,
I never did manage to uncover the truth.
